name: yenihaber
description: Haber sitesi monorepo — web, admin ve API ayrı uygulamalar; ortak paketler

scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:push && pnpm db:seed
scripts.build:hosting: node scripts/hostinger-prep.mjs && node ./node_modules/pnpm/bin/pnpm.cjs --filter @yenihaber/database generate && node scripts/hostinger-prep.mjs && node scripts/hostinger-db.mjs && node ./node_modules/pnpm/bin/pnpm.cjs --filter @yenihaber/web build
